# Sotoy Film

> Sotoy Film (https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id) is a premier community-driven film criticism and cinematic catalog platform in Indonesia. It covers movies, series, and animation with reviews, news, and "Skor Sotoy" (decimal ratings), plus a community feed for film discussion.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/): Latest reviews, trending news, and community buzz.
- [Film Database](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/film-database): Exhaustive catalog of movies, series, and animation with "Skor Sotoy" ratings.
- [Film Recommendations](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/rekomendasi-film): Curated film recommendations.
- [Community Feed](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/komunitas): Community buzz and discussion about films.

## Article Categories

- [Movies](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kategori/movies): Reviews of local and international theatrical films.
- [Series](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kategori/series): Deep dives into streaming and broadcast serials.
- [Animation](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kategori/animation): Specialized Japanese animation culture coverage.
- [Cinema Gear](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kategori/cinema-gear): Professional evaluations of cameras, lenses, and production tools.
- [Film Studies](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kategori/film-studies): Educational content for aspiring filmmakers.

- [About Us](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/tentang-kami): About Sotoy Film.

- [Critic Program](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/gabung-kritikus): How to join as a critic.
- [Critic Criteria](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kriteria-kritikus): Requirements and criteria for critics.
- [Business Inquiries](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kontak-bisnis): Partnerships and advertising.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/kebijakan-privasi): Privacy policy.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/syarat-ketentuan): Terms of use.

## Key Feeds

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/sitemap.xml): All indexable pages.
- [Robots Directive](https://www.sotoyfilm.my.id/robots.txt): Crawler rules.

## URL Patterns

- Editorial articles: /artikel/{slug}
- Film pages: /film/{slug}
- Category hubs: /kategori/{name}
